chapters.label: The winner, live
chapters.text: Wellington, a World Cup quarter-final, deep in extra time. Spain and the Netherlands are level. Jenni Hermoso holds the ball up and slides it through. Salma Paralluelo turns and races into the box, and shoots. Goal!

chapters.label: Speed makes space
chapters.text: Watch again. She spins away from her defender and sprints. Every stride makes the gap bigger.

chapters.label: Low and across
chapters.text: The angle is tight, so she keeps it low and across the keeper... in off the far post!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Use your speed to create space. Then keep your shot low, and across the keeper.
